annotations.title: Get the status of a build

description: Use this when the person asks how a Pugi build or change is going, or for a fresh preview link. In hosts that render the build card (MCP Apps or ChatGPT widget), the card tracks progress automatically: do not poll job_status. In hosts without a build card (Claude Code or API), call job_status with the job_id until the job is finished, stopped or failed. Preview links expire after 15 minutes; call again for a fresh link.

job_id.description: The job_id build_site, build_app or edit returned.

name: job_status
